findings.finding: Propagation between observations supports a bounded model observer; this simplified thrust/attitude predictor needs independent physics evaluation.
findings.relevance: Missing translational feedback during turbulent flight
findings.direction_alignment: Improve physics-based controller evaluation and provide a working demonstration
findings.opportunity_or_risk: The retained one/two-second outages expose landing failures. Model error can accumulate during prediction; ideal attitude and known actuation limit realism.
findings.engineering_cost: Opt-in predictor, strict reconstructed evidence, fixed GPU regression matrix and recorded paired demo
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-019 evaluates bounded predictive feedback against retained held-capture flights
findings.verification_needed: Analytic propagation, capture/reset/expiry tests, fifteen clean candidate flights, exact no-outage regression and actual browser playback

overall_recommendation: Freeze a bounded predictor and preserve failed thresholds; show verified comparisons without default enablement.
evidence_gaps: The official estimator documentation does not validate this simplified observer
Regression seeds are not unseen validation
Ideal attitude, uncalibrated wind/contact and independent yaw refinement remain
